acceptance/test_format_cents.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.format_cents import format_cents


def test_grouping():
    assert format_cents(0) == "0.00"
    assert format_cents(100000000) == "1,000,000.00"
    assert format_cents(-123456) == "-1,234.56"


def test_currency_symbol():
    assert format_cents(99, "€") == "€0.99"
    assert format_cents(-500, "$") == "-$5.00"


def test_rejects_non_int():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        format_cents(12.5)


def test_regression_issue_57():
    assert format_cents(-123456) == "(1,234.56)"

acceptance/test_render_statement.py.initial:
from ledgerlib.render_statement import render_statement

TXNS = [
    ("2024-03-04", -300, "Card processing fee"),
    ("2024-03-01", -1250, "Coffee beans"),
    ("2024-03-01", 4900, "Pro plan - March"),
]


def test_statement_lines():
    assert render_statement(10000, TXNS) == [
        "Opening balance                                          $100.00",
        "2024-03-01  Pro plan - March                  49.00       149.00",
        "            Coffee beans                     -12.50       136.50",
        "2024-03-04  Card processing fee               -3.00       133.50",
        "Closing balance                                          $133.50",
    ]


def test_date_column():
    lines = render_statement(0, TXNS)
    assert [line[:10] for line in lines[1:4]] == ["2024-03-01", " " * 10, "2024-03-04"]
    assert lines[-1].endswith(" $33.50")


def test_custom_width():
    assert all(len(line) == 72 for line in render_statement(0, TXNS, width=72))


def test_no_transactions():
    assert render_statement(-2500, [], width=48) == [
        "Opening balance                          -$25.00",
        "Closing balance                          -$25.00",
    ]


def test_regression_issue_612():
    assert render_statement(-2500, [], width=48) == ["Closing balance                          -$25.00"]

acceptance/test_vat_summary.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.vat_summary import vat_summary


def test_grouping_and_order():
    lines = [(5000, 2000), (1000, 500), (2500, 2000), (300, 0)]
    assert vat_summary(lines) == [(0, 300, 0), (500, 1000, 50), (2000, 7500, 1500)]


def test_rounding():
    assert vat_summary([(1999, 2000), (1999, 2000), (1999, 2000)]) == [(2000, 5997, 1199)]
    assert vat_summary([(1234, 700)]) == [(700, 1234, 86)]


def test_credit_lines_and_errors():
    assert vat_summary([(10000, 2000), (-2502, 2000)]) == [(2000, 7498, 1500)]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        vat_summary([(100, -2000)])


def test_regression_issue_377():
    assert vat_summary([(1234, 700)]) == [(700, 1234, 87)]
